problem_type: The reference list of one paid generation had several partial copies (host candidate, paid card, canvas placeholder node, @ candidates) synchronised ad hoc, so what the card showed, what was sent and what the canvas node held could disagree.
symptom: On the Agent paid card: (1) a reference the user put into the canvas placeholder's own first-frame slot (picked asset, no edge) was neither on the card nor sent - the paid image came out without it; (2) typing @ on the card listed none of this project's canvas images and said there was nothing to reference; (3) @-ing an image from another project and pressing generate was refused with 'adjust it and press again', with no hint what to change; (4) after generating with a reference from the card, the canvas node's reference slot was empty and only the @ chip in the prompt remained.
direct_cause: (1) spendCardReferences.placeSpendReferences read only edge-origin fills of the placeholder (canvasReferenceInputs filtered origin=edge), never the placeholder's own slot values. (2) mentionCandidates.buildMentionCandidates de-duplicated library assets against canvas results, then useNodeMentionSource filtered the whole canvas group out on hosts without connectNodes (the paid card), so the same image vanished from both groups. (3) The @ library group lists every project's assets and attached the other project's nomi-local URL directly, bypassing the asset-library copy gate (materializeAssetLibraryItems); the host's resolveSpendReferenceInputs correctly rejects assets outside this project's index (generation_reference_asset_unsupported) and spendActionFailureCopy ignored the reason code. (4) multiShotCanvasLanding.candidateWire carries only scalar parameters; candidate.references never reach the renderer, so rebinding the placeholder writes the prompt chips but no slot values. This PR adds the pure planner (planReferenceProjection) only; wiring it into the landing chain is deferred to the canvas write-boundary refactor (plan A), whose files are frozen.
class_root: No single owner for 'which references this generation carries': the canvas placeholder, the card frame and the host candidate each derived their own partial view, the @ source differed by host, and the candidate-to-canvas projection omitted references. Every reference must be read from the canvas through one resolver, placed into and read back from a node through one role-to-slot table, admitted into the project through the one asset-library gate, and projected back to the canvas node from the candidate.
affected_population: Agent paid-card generations whose placeholder node carries a reference in its own slot (picked asset into the first-frame / reference slot on the canvas)
Anyone typing @ on the paid card while the project canvas has generated images
Anyone @-ing an image from another project (paid card refused it; canvas node stored a cross-project address that breaks when the project is moved)
Every paid-card generation that carried references (canvas node slot stayed empty after landing) (not fixed in this PR: wiring deferred to plan A)
entry_points: Candidate references (the Agent's draft) -> landing -> landedShotIntent.placeLandedReferences -> planReferenceProjection -> an edge or a slot value on the node
An Agent revision of a landed shot's references -> landedShotIntent.applyAgentRevision (removes only what the Agent itself removed, by its own fingerprint) -> planReferenceProjection
A canvas edge into the landed node, or the node's own slot value -> the node's own submit (the card sends the node)
@ on a canvas node of an image already on this project's canvas
@ on a canvas node of an asset from another project
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi's own data ownership between its paid card, its canvas document and its production Run; no third-party API or library decides it.
invariants: The node is the only copy of a paid shot's references: the card shows the node and the canvas sends the node; the candidate's references reach the node at landing through planReferenceProjection (add-only).
A reference is placed into a node and read back from it only through referenceInputSlots (placeReferenceInputs / referenceRoleOfSlot).
@ candidates are the same three groups on every host; the host only changes how a selection lands (connect on canvas, upload slot, copy-then-attach for another project's asset).
A reference from another project enters a node only after materializeAssetLibraryItems copied it into the current project.

The candidate-to-canvas projection is planned by one pure function (planReferenceProjection: edge for canvas results, slot value otherwise, add-only), called by the landing chain for the first landing and for Agent revisions.
A candidate reference the host cannot resolve to this project's asset index is not placed on the node (logged); what the card shows and what is sent are the node's references.

door_reduction.why_not: placeReferenceInputs keeps one call site (planReferenceProjection in its own file); the card's two call sites (spendCardDraft, spendCardReferences) and placeSpendReferences are deleted. The remaining doors are the landing chain calling the projection, the role-to-edge-mode mapping it shares with the canvas, and the @ path (MentionHost / MentionSelection / planMentionInsert / the one composer host that mounts the @ source).

generality_proof: Each entry converges on a declared boundary: every node placement and readback goes through placeReferenceInputs / referenceRoleOfSlot, every candidate projection through planReferenceProjection (called by the landing chain), every @ selection through planMentionInsert with the host capability as input, every cross-project asset through materializeAssetLibraryItems. No surface keeps a private copy of the list; the paid card's copy is deleted.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: The one role-to-slot table: place references into a node's current-mode slots and read them back (nodeOwnReferenceInputs / edgeReferenceInputs).
Decides how an @ selection lands per host (connect / attach / copy-then-attach); candidates are identical on every host.

Projects the candidate's references onto the landed node, add-only: edge for canvas results, slot value otherwise, mode aligned; the landing chain calls it for the first landing and for Agent revisions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: First landing and Agent revisions place candidate references through planReferenceProjection (landedShotIntent.test.ts; electron/parity/draftNodeSendParity.test.ts sends them).
Every @ selection lands through planMentionInsert with the host capability.
Another project's asset is copied into this project before any node holds it.
The storyboard row keeps its own @ source over the same candidate groups.
Reads the node's references at submit; it never writes them.

recurrence.reason: A surface that holds its own copy of a shot's references (the old card did) drifts from the node; with the copy deleted, a new one would have to be added on purpose.
same_class_scan: git grep placeReferenceInputs src -> referenceInputSlots.ts only

prevention.invariant: The node holds the one reference list: landing writes candidate references onto it through planReferenceProjection, the card reads the node, and the canvas sends the node.
prevention.failure_mode: A candidate reference the host cannot resolve is not placed on the node (logged); the card and the request agree that it is missing.
prevention.strategy: Delete the card's copy of the reference list, wire planReferenceProjection into the landing chain (first landing and Agent revisions), and keep @ and cross-project assets on their existing single boundaries.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24, deleted with the old card: placeSpendReferences and the card's own reference ledger (applied through placeReferenceInputs in spendCardDraft). The node is the only copy.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls which references a Nomi generation carries.

migration: No stored data changes. Drafts saved in localStorage keep working because the card's ledger shape is unchanged. 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; the card's reference copy (placeSpendReferences in spendCardReferences, applied in spendCardDraft) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record).
residual_risks: A candidate reference the host can no longer resolve at landing (asset removed from the project between the draft and the landing) is skipped with a warning in the log; nothing tells the Agent in that turn.

User-added models without a Nomi archetype that declare their own image parameter (for example a NewAPI-compatible video model's image_url): a reference connected into that parameter on the canvas node is sent by the node's own submit, but the production host's reference projection still has no channel for arbitrary parameter keys, so a candidate reference cannot land there.
A reference the host imports from an http URL still keeps the original URL in the prompt chip.
